name.zh: MGC3 Beta 三阶 Aero (磁悬浮 + UV)

note.zh: 商品页明示的 Added 建档日期，不等同于全球首发；未采用 Shopify published_at 代替首发。
note.en: The product page’s explicit Added date, not a worldwide launch; Shopify published_at is not used as a launch date.

adjustment.zh: 6 档弹力 × 5 档轴距，共 30 种中心设置。
adjustment.en: 6 compression × 5 travel levels, for 30 center settings.

note.zh: 2026-10-07 检索的本具体版本美国页面标价；库存另核，税运费另计，不是中国首发价。
note.en: US listing price for this exact SKU observed October 7, 2026; stock, tax and shipping vary; not a Chinese launch price.

highlights.zh: Aero 采用中空减料内构，72 g，磁悬浮与 UV；保留传统轴心，未使用球轴磁力。
highlights.en: Aero uses hollowed internals, at 72 g, with MagLev and UV; it keeps a traditional core without ball-core magnetism.

highlights.zh: 本版本配置：磁悬浮弹力、块间磁力定位、UV 亮面。
highlights.en: This version: MagLev elasticity, piece-to-piece magnetic guidance, UV gloss finish.

summary.zh: 通过内构减料提供 Beta 系列中的轻量磁悬浮配置。
summary.en: Provides a lighter MagLev configuration in the Beta range through material cutouts.

tradeoffs.zh: 减重与磁悬浮不等于更强定位；本款没有其他 Beta 球轴版的角轴磁力。
tradeoffs.en: Lower mass and MagLev do not establish stronger guidance; this version lacks the corner/core magnets of ball-core Betas.

highlights.zh: 透明六色机身内含 8 颗引导灯，以机身灯光提示下一步；弹力采用磁悬浮，配合 WCU 应用记录。

highlights.zh: 本版本配置：弹簧回弹、块间磁力定位。
highlights.en: This version: spring elasticity, piece-to-piece magnetic guidance.

summary.zh: 把智能三阶的记录功能扩展到机身可视复原引导。
summary.en: Extends smart-cube tracking into visible guidance on the cube itself.

tradeoffs.zh: 8 颗灯不等于 8 颗轴磁；商家表中磁轴用词有混淆，因此没有据名称填写角轴磁体数量。
